exception_reason: The archive records the parent Git HEAD, while source and configuration changes required by the full-data run were first committed together with the generated artifacts. The exact dirty worktree used for training cannot be proven retroactively.
acceptance_basis: Project owner directive on 2026-09-16 to treat the three archived training modes and their results as final.
future_run_policy: New formal runs must still use configs with provenance.require_clean_git=true.
